From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
To: rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai, vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai, laura.bennett@redwood.ai, marcus.lin@redwood.ai, Sarah Lim <sarah.lim@acme.com>, Tom Becker <tbecker@gestalt.io>

Subject: Quarterly readout prep — inference sales ops pulse and account digests

Team,

We need a compact packet for next week's executive readout (Nov 9). Goal: a one-page pipeline "ledger" + concise account digests for the top 12 deals that could move the needle. High-level asks below — please keep answers short and action-focused.

Deliverables (due EOD Nov 4):
- Consolidated pipeline ledger (canonical forecast numbers by ARR/close probability).
- Per-account one-paragraph digest (current ask, blockers, next milestone, owner).
- Any SOW/Procurement docs that will affect timing.

Priority accounts to cover (minimum): Acme Corp, Gestalt Analytics, BigBank Procurement. If you think another account should be in the top 12, flag it with a one-line rationale.

Attachments: initial template attached and sample account digest. [attachment: Pipeline_ledger_template.csv]

I'll compile and produce the executive one-pager on Nov 5. If you can't hit EOD Nov 4, call it out here with ETA.

Thanks — Olga
Olga Petrov
Director, Sales Ops | Redwood Inference
olga.petrov@redwood.ai
[attachment: Redwood_QBR_Prep_Checklist.md]

Appreciate the fast turn. A couple of framing notes for the exec one-pager:

- Highlight runway deals (close in next 30 days) separately so we can clearly call expected ARR motion.
- Flag any deals that require SLA/exception asks to Legal/Platform (we need to know uplift impact).
- For Acme: if legal holds on the SOW timing, we should show a conservative and an optimistic funnel; keep both numbers in the ledger.

Rishi — where are we on the consolidated probabilities? Laura/Marcus — can you spot-check the top-5 digests for consistency (one-liners only)?

I'll escalate procurement timing with BigBank if needed (their PO process has 2–3 touches with Finance).

From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
To: rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai, vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai, laura.bennett@redwood.ai, marcus.lin@redwood.ai, Sarah Lim <sarah.lim@acme.com>, Tom Becker <tbecker@gestalt.io>, Procurement <procure@bigbank.com>
Date: 2026-11-05T17:03:00-08:00
Subject: Consolidated ledger and account digests — final packet (for exec deck)

Team / partners,

Attached is the consolidated packet for tomorrow's readout. Quick summary below and a short action list.

Attachments included: Redwood_QBR_Playbook_v1.pdf (executive one-pager + appendix), Pipeline_ledger_20261102.csv (final numbers), Acme_SOW_draft.docx. [attachment: Redwood_QBR_Playbook_v1.pdf]

Executive summary (one paragraph each):
- Acme Corp: Targeting Nov close; legal redlines received. Conservative: $420k (60%); Optimistic: $620k (90%) if SOW acceptance window reduced to 45 days. Action: Rishi to confirm revised close date post-legal review.
- Gestalt Analytics: POC budget increased, potential to convert in Q1; current ask is additional infra credits to finish scale test. Action: Marcus to own infra credit approval request.
- BigBank Procurement: Long procurement runway; requiring PO + SOC2 evidence. Action: Laura to coordinate audit evidence and timeline with Security.

Numbers at-a-glance (from ledger):
- Total weighted ARR (top 12): $2.1M (conservative), $2.9M (optimistic)
- Runway deals (next 30d expected closes): $780k (weighted)

Action items (owner — due):
- Rishi: confirm Acme close date & update ledger (Nov 6 EOD).
- Marcus: prepare infra-credit ask for Gestalt (Nov 6 AM).
- Laura: compile SOC2 evidence and confirm retention policy for BigBank (Nov 7).
- Olga: produce final exec one-pager and upload to Drive (done). Link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cQBRPrep

If there are any last-minute redlines to the numbers, reply-all with the delta and source (contract / PO / legal comment). Thanks all for moving fast.

Olga
Director, Sales Ops | Redwood Inference
[attachment: Redwood_QBR_Playbook_v1.pdf]
